core.title: Revere Solid Brass Grab, Fusion GRB-904

text.description_html:
Fusion GRB-904, Revere 8 Inch Door Grab

Fusion's Revere Grab is designed with classic styles in mind. What brings this otherwise simple appliance pull to life is the beaded design--it gives it a more modern feel without straying into the minimalistic appearance of the contemporary style. Instead, this grab is very now, unlimited by the ornate style of times gone by and the striped down approach of modernism. It has just the right amount of detailing and can range from detailed to very simple. Versatility is what this pull is all about, made only more apparent by the fact that it is available in 4 finishes.

Specifications and Features of the 8" Revere Pull:

  • Length: 8" center to center
  • Material: solid brass
  • Packaged with appliance panel mounting screws.

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
